notes: Ball-only hard-slice gold pass (workstream D2-06): stroke/phase/checkpoint fields intentionally unlabeled. Method: frames decoded by absolute frame index at the exact container frame rate (ffmpeg select=eq(n\,IDX), no -ss seeking); every committed point measured on a zoomed pixel crop of the decoded frame and re-verified in a 4x centered crop; radiusNorm = ball radius px / frame height, omitted where blur or partial overlap makes it unmeasurable. Occluded frames carry NO point by rule; uncertain frames carry no point and no occlusionState. Append-only sidecar; no existing label touched. RECORDING clock (rec-6e06a3157947, afn-sasebo-indoor, 29.97fps), tMs=round(n*1000/29.97), same convention as the wave-a event annotation; all frames within the event window [51600..54600]. Hard slices covered: through-net-mesh visibility, net-tape/paddle partial overlaps, fast-volley motion blur, a background-court second ball, and the post-rally ball-toss (wave-a reviewed ~53954 as post-rally milling; my 53988-54088 points are that toss). The ball passes behind the near target's torso from ~54621, outside the window, so no occluded frame is committed here.
